articles.abstract: Classical anatomical and physiological studies have established the cortico-basal ganglia–thalamic (CBGT) system as a set of topographically organized, functionally specialized circuits that link the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia and thalamus while allowing convergence and interaction between information streams. Recent advances in mesoscale and single-neuron connectomics now

articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Antipsychotics (APs) induce functional, anatomical, and metabolic brain changes in schizophrenia, but the nature and clinical significance of these effects remain debated. Focusing on first-episode psychosis (FEP) allows distinction between medication-induced and illness-related brain changes and facilitates identification of early predictors of treatment response.
articles.abstract_zh: 背景：抗精神病药物（AP）在精神分裂症患者中诱导功能、解剖和代谢脑变化，但这些效应的性质和临床意义仍存在争议。聚焦于首发精神病（FEP）允许在药物效应和疾病相关脑变化之间进行区分，并有助于识别早期治疗响应预测因子。设计：遵循PRISMA指南（PROSPERO：CRD42021240369），我们系统回顾了首发精神病患者的纵向脑成像研究，旨在1）识别抗精神病药物诱导的脑变化，2）识别与临床改善相关的脑变化，3）探索预测治疗响应的神经影像生

articles.snippet: The brain's ability to learn, adapt, and recover hinges on synaptic plasticity, yet most large-scale neural models overlook this core feature. In this review, we argue that embedding plasticity is essential for the simulation of realistic population-level brain activity. To this end, we explore specific computational attempts at scaling microscopic single-neuron plasticity rule

articles.abstract: Anthropogenic noise is a rapidly expanding global pollutant, but its effects across biological levels from individuals to ecosystems remain unquantified. We conducted phylogenetically controlled meta-analyses of 214 experimental studies on 177 aquatic and terrestrial species with ranges that span six continents. articles.abstract_zh: 人为噪音是快速扩散的全球污染物，但其从个体到生态系统的生物层面影响尚未量化。我们对六大洲范围的177种水生和陆生物种进行了214项实验研究的系统发育控制元分析。噪音在研究的80%物种中改变了至少一个生理、发育或行为特征，导致适应力和丰度下降，并扰乱捕食者-猎物相互作用。噪音的影响遍布所有栖息地，尽管针对某些特征和物种的反应机制有所不同，产生了赢家和输家。只有多物种分析才能揭示此类人为压力源对物种和生态系统的影响。我们的研究结果确立了噪音

articles.title_zh: 2800年前直接证据使用精神活性大麻
articles.abstract: Cannabis is the world’s most-used illicit psychoactive plant, yet direct prehistoric evidence for its consumption is rare. In this study, we present the earliest direct evidence of cannabis use: offerings of plant parts and chemical compounds in ancient human hair recovered from a monumental tomb in Siberia. The findings suggest that the plant was used for its psychoactive qual
articles.abstract_zh: 大麻是世界上使用最广泛的迷幻植物，但其史前使用的直接证据很少。在这项研究中，我们展示了大麻使用最早的直接证据：从西伯利亚一座宏伟陵墓中出土的人类头发中包含植物部位和化学化合物的供品。研究结果表明，大麻因其精神活性特性在欧亚大陆被使用，其中特定的野生种群可能天然含有更高水平的活性化合物。我们证明，大麻使用的习俗至少可追溯至2800年前，这为当前的使用争论提供了依据，也为医学、公共卫生、法律和工业界关于大麻的讨论提供了信息。

articles.abstract: How and when the subduction megathrust recovers its locking state after a great earthquake is important to understanding earthquake-cycle physics and future hazards. Here we report the delineation of the relocking process after the 2011 magnitude 9 Tohoku earthquake with 14 years of postseismic seafloor geodetic observations. These data, combined with onshore geodetic observati
articles.abstract_zh: 亚大陆板块在大地震后如何以及何时恢复锁定状态，对于理解地震周期物理机制和未来危害至关重要。在此，我们利用2011年M9东北地震后14年的海底测绘后位移观测数据，结合陆上测绘观测、重复地震分析和数值建模，揭示了锁定恢复过程如何被逆冲作用中断，并伴随上地幔粘弹性应力放大。结果表明，尽管存在持续的应力放大，但目前地幔逆冲区已恢复至与地震前相似的锁定状态。这些成果有助于在其他俯冲带揭示地震周期物理机制。

articles.abstract: Elastocaloric cooling (eC) uses shape memory alloys (SMAs) as energy-efficient, eco-friendly refrigerants. However, cost-effectively fabricating SMAs into fatigue-resistant, heat transfer–enhanced structures remains a key obstacle to commercialization of the eC technology. We introduce a “stamping and stacking” (S-S) method for producing porous, fatigue-resistant SMA structures
articles.abstract_zh: 弹热冷却（eC）利用形状记忆合金（SMAs）作为节能、环保的制冷剂。然而，以低成本将SMAs制造成耐疲劳、增强传热的结构，仍然是eC技术商业化的关键障碍。我们提出了一种“压制与堆叠”（S-S）方法，用于制造多孔、耐疲劳的SMAs结构。从镍钛（NiTi）薄板上冲压出蜂窝状芯片，并将其堆叠成分层管状结构，以增加热交换表面积的同时，避免现有SMAs结构中遇到的弯曲和分裂失效。堆叠结构经受了>10^8次压缩循环，并可提供每公斤3850瓦的高比冷

articles.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）在病理上以淀粉样斑块和神经纤维样缠结为特征，然而这些典型病变单独无法解释其临床、区域和细胞层面的异质性。AD是一种多细胞、空间组织的疾病，由神经元、胶质细胞和血管细胞在不同解剖微环境中的相互作用塑造。单细胞和单核RNA测序技术使得能够解析AD大脑中个体细胞群体的转录特征，揭示了选择性神经元脆弱性、随阶段变化的胶质重塑以及广泛的细胞间通讯网络破坏；而空间转录组学和多重成像则将这些分子变化锚定于组织语境。研究自变异性AD

articles.abstract_zh: 帕金森病（PD）是一种异质性的神经退行性疾病，其特征是进展和治疗反应的可变性。在过去的三十年中，遗传学发现重塑了我们对PD生物学的理解，鉴定出罕见的单基因形式、强遗传风险变异以及对PD遗传性贡献各异的大量常见和罕见遗传变异。这些发现导致鉴定出参与神经退行性过程的关键途径，包括蛋白质加工错误、溶酶体和线粒体功能障碍以及免疫反应改变。在本综述中，我们描述了PD遗传学的演变，并讨论了其当前的临床影响及在精准医疗中的未来作用，从诊断、预后到疾病

articles.abstract_zh: 报道迷幻药物对小鼠行为影响的研究正在快速增多。然而，这些效应的可重复性和可靠性仍不确定。本研究采用多机构协作方法，评估裸盖菇素对小鼠行为的哪些效应是稳健且可重复的。五个独立实验室进行了相同实验，以测定裸盖菇素（2 mg kg−1，腹腔注射）的急性和持续效应。裸盖菇素在稳健且可重复的方式下急性增加了焦虑和回避相关行为，并减少了恐惧表达。然而，令人惊讶的是，裸盖菇素在给药24小时后，在减少焦虑和抑郁样行为或促进恐惧消退学习方面并没有可重复的

articles.title: AI ‘slop’ is a social judgement
articles.title_zh: AI‘垃圾信息’是一种社会判断
articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content increasingly saturates our information environment. Efforts to detect and remove it are failing. We propose that calling AI-generated content ‘slop’ is best understood as a social judgement: what a community recognizes as unwanted AI content. Studying AI slop this way makes it tractable, measurable and governable.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）生成的内容正日益饱和我们的信息环境。旁检和删除的努力正在失败。我们提议，将AI生成的内容称为‘垃圾信息’，最好被理解为一种社会判断：社区将其识别为不想要的AI内容。以这种方式研究AI‘垃圾信息’使其变得可操作、可测量且可治理。
articles.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content increasingly saturates our information environment. Efforts to detect and remove it are failing. We propose that calling AI-generated content ‘slop’ is best understood as a social judgement: what a community recognizes as unwanted AI content. Studying AI slop this way makes it tractable, measurable and governable.

articles.abstract_zh: 记忆巩固是学习中的关键过程，新信息和技能在休息期间离线加强。研究通常在小时到天的时间尺度上研究巩固，但近期研究已识别出跨秒尺度的快速巩固，称为‘微巩固’。在行为层面，已通过休息/练习时长的操作、序列任务范式以及干扰或双重任务的添加来探究微巩固。学习中在线和离线贡献的相对比例取决于任务的性质/需求，可能受注意力、‘反向抑制’以及疲劳效应的影响。海马神经重放和前额叶网络离线β波活动的证据强力支持微巩固机制，并与观察到行为的替代解释不兼容。

articles.title: Effort-based decision-making: A value-guided dissection and arousal-focused synthesis
articles.title_zh: 基于努力的决策：价值引导的解剖与聚焦唤醒综合
articles.abstract: Work often leads to better outcomes in terms of health, nutrition, and reproductive success, suggesting that work execution should be favored by natural selection. However, work also involves expending energy and time, costs that biological systems aim to limit. Indeed, work is often accompanied by the subjectively aversive experience of effort, which motivates work avoidance.
articles.abstract_zh: 工作往往能在健康、营养和繁殖成功方面取得更好的结果，这表明工作执行应被自然选择所青睐。然而，工作也需要消耗能量和时间，这些是生物系统旨在限制的成本。确实，工作常伴随着主观上令人不快的努力体验，这会促使人们避免工作。因此，决策者在采取任何行动前，需要在目标工作的预期利益与预期努力成本之间权衡。虽然这种权衡相对较为充分地描述，但基于努力的决策涉及几个其他关键组成部分，包括对预期努力的表征以及将其与体验到的努力进行比较，这使得学习成为可能。这
articles.snippet: Work often leads to better outcomes in terms of health, nutrition, and reproductive success, suggesting that work execution should be favored by natural selection. However, work also involves expending energy and time, costs that biological systems aim to limit. Indeed, work is often accompanied by the subjectively aversive experience of effort, which motivates work avoidance.

articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员和普通大众普遍认为，浪漫吸引至少部分取决于潜在伴侣是否具备一个人声称想要的特质。然而，最近的研究表明，此类偏好匹配效应（Preference × Trait 统计交互作用）往往出奇地小，甚至完全缺失。可能的心理学解释包括：（i）配偶选择是多维的，因此任何单一特质的匹配效应都受到严重限制，以及（ii）特质允许灵活解释，即相同的特质在不同伴侣身上可能被不同地解读。兼容性可能主要源于两人随着时间的推移反复延伸并建立在共享的积极经验之上

articles.abstract_zh: 为实现全球粮食安全目标并减少农业环境影响，持续的作物改良与创新至关重要。转基因、同源转基因以及基因组编辑的进步，使得基因修饰日益精准，其风险与传统育种相近，然而监管框架仍聚焦于修饰手段而非产品本身。我们综述了近期案例，包括免疫受体转移、同源转基因抗病性堆叠、光合作用工程以及AI引导的蛋白质设计，阐释了当前监管方式如何制约创新。必须向科学依据、适度且以产品为导向的监管转型，以便根据作物性状而非其生产方式对改良作物进行评估。

Their work raises important new questions about how CR impacts the causal mechanisms of aging.

articles.title: AI governance needs to consider users’ emotional responses

articles.abstract: People will often trust or distrust an artificial intelligence (AI) output because of how it makes them feel, rather than how reliable it is. AI governance frameworks should require that platforms disclose design choices that target user emotions, allow users control over these, and include features aimed to calibrate trust.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们往往因为人工智能（AI）的输出让他们产生何种感觉而信任或不信任它，而不是因为它的可靠性。AI治理框架应要求平台披露旨在针对用户情感的设计选择，允许用户对这些设计进行控制，并包含旨在校准信任的功能。
articles.snippet: People will often trust or distrust an artificial intelligence (AI) output because of how it makes them feel, rather than how reliable it is. articles.abstract: The science of emotion increasingly relies on machine learning (ML) in the hope of making objective discoveries that resolve century-long debates. articles.abstract_zh: 情感科学正日益依赖机器学习（ML），以期通过客观发现解决长期争议。本文考察了两大研究传统中的研究策略，并展示了当基于理论的假设采用带有理论色彩的抽样策略、模型规范和推断时，如何产生确认偏差。每种传统在其 ML 方法中体现了理论差异，因此 ML 方法无法解决这些差异。起始假设、发现与结论之间的相互关系表明，像所有科学研究一样，情感的 ML 调查从未摆脱人类经验和信念的影响；然而，通过采用理论意识的研究策略，可减少偏差，从而生成更有依据的情

articles.abstract: The mammalian cerebral cortex undergoes profound functional changes during early postnatal development. During this period, neurons generate spontaneous electrical activity long before sensory experience, coordinating into distinct patterns of synchronous activity. articles.abstract_zh: 哺乳动物大脑皮层在早期产后发育期间经历深刻的功能变化。在此期间，神经元在感官经验之前产生自发电活动，并协调成不同的同步活动模式。传统上，神经元活动被视为通过调节转录程序、形态和连接性来指导抑制性神经元的发育。然而，啮齿类动物研究积累的证据表明，这种关系是双向的：皮层抑制性神经元不仅仅是活动依赖信号的被动接收者，而且是发育中网络动力学的主动架构师。它们调节自发活动从Gap连接介导的同步事件向大型突触驱动爆发，以及随后向成熟电路特征的稀疏放

articles.title_zh: 蛋白-配体结合预测中基于结构的方法评估指南
articles.abstract: Scoring functions built with advanced deep learning algorithms have recently gained prominence in protein–ligand pose generation and binding affinity prediction for computational drug design. However, several shortcomings make it increasingly difficult to evaluate scoring functions for a specific task across studies. Transparent disclosure of training data, code and procedures
articles.abstract_zh: 基于先进深度学习算法的评分函数在计算药物设计中的蛋白-配体构象生成和结合亲和力预测中最近备受关注。然而，几个局限性使得在特定任务 across studies 中评估评分函数日益困难。透明披露训练数据、代码和实验过程对于允许可重用、可重现性和独立审查至关重要。防止数据泄漏、采样偏差和有缺陷的设计同样重要。评分函数之间有意义的比较还需要共同的数据分割、运行间变异性检查和性能基线。本文提出了一套指南，帮助社区识别解决这些重要问题的最有前景的
articles.snippet: Scoring functions built with advanced deep learning algorithms have recently gained prominence in protein–ligand pose generation and binding affinity prediction for computational drug design. articles.title: Refining a new movement by practicing it upside down
articles.title_zh: 倒立练习中对新运动的精细化
articles.abstract: In this study, participants improved at copying an unfamiliar alphabet character even though they only practiced writing rotated versions of it. The experiments reveal that the motor system can refine movements by creating an abstraction of their structure, and not only by repeating the same mechanical muscle commands.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，参与者在仅练习旋转版本的情况下，仍提高了复写不熟悉字母字符的能力。实验揭示，运动系统可以通过构建其结构的抽象来精细化运动，而不仅仅是重复相同的机器肌肉指令。
articles.snippet: In this study, participants improved at copying an unfamiliar alphabet character even though they only practiced writing rotated versions of it. articles.title: Tumor innervation in non-central nervous system tumors: origins, mechanisms, and phenotypic plasticity
articles.title_zh: 非中枢神经系统肿瘤的神经支配：起源、机制与表型可塑性
articles.abstract: The peripheral nervous system has emerged as an important regulator of solid tumor biology. articles.abstract_zh: 外周神经系统已成为实体瘤生物学的重要调控者。本文综述了癌症神经科学的最新进展，聚焦于三个相互关联的主题：肿瘤相关神经的细胞起源、调控神经招募与重塑的分子机制，以及由此产生的肿瘤微环境中的表型可塑性。肿瘤神经支配通过已有神经轴突延伸、神经前体细胞招募以及非神经细胞的神经样转分化等途径实现。这些过程受神经营养因子、轴突引导信号、细胞外囊泡和应激相关通路的驱动。神经支配的功能后果取决于情境，交感、副交感和感觉输入在不同肿瘤类型和阶段表现出不同

articles.abstract: For decades, core knowledge accounts have proposed that early cognition is organized by innate, domain-specific conceptual or concept-like representations of objects, physical events, number, and agents. articles.abstract: Blood biomarkers are transforming Alzheimer's disease diagnostics by enabling a scalable, minimally invasive assessment of pathology. articles.title: Running in reverse: Tau redirects mitochondrial electron flow toward neurodegeneration

articles.abstract: In this issue of Neuron, Li et al.1 show that tau enters mitochondria and binds NDUFS3 to regulate reverse electron transport (RET) in a phosphorylation-dependent manner. RET promotes tau phosphorylation, forming a self-perpetuating loop that is exacerbated with stress and tauopathy.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本期《Neuron》杂志中，Li 等人1 发现 Tau 进入线粒体并结合 NDUFS3，以磷酸化依赖方式调节逆向电子传递（RET）。RET 促进 Tau 的磷酸化，形成自我维持的循环，且在应激和 Tau 病理状态下被放大。

articles.abstract: Human-machine interfaces, such as augmented reality devices, hand prostheses, and brain-computer interfaces, are increasingly being used in neurorehabilitation. In this issue of Neuron, Vassiliadis et al.1 examine the interaction between closed-loop continuous reinforcement and sensory feedback in learning of human-machine interface control.

articles.title_zh: 小鼠进食诱导胃分泌的迷走神经肠脑轴
articles.abstract: Feeding begins with food-seeking and ends with nutrient absorption and waste elimination. Although meal-related sensory cues shape feeding behavior, how they engage neural circuits to control digestion remains unclear. articles.title: Metazoan lagging-strand DNA synthesis is distributive
articles.title_zh: 多细胞动物的滞后链 DNA 合成是分散式的
articles.abstract: DNA's anti-parallel structure presents a topological challenge to the replisome, as leading and lagging strands must be synthesized in opposite directions. How lagging-strand synthesis is coordinated with leading-strand synthesis remains unresolved in eukaryotes. To address this question, we directly visualized the dynamics of lagging-strand polymerases Pol α and Pol δ at activ

articles.title: MCT6 is an intestinal Lac-Phe exporter required for metformin-associated weight loss
articles.title_zh: MCT6是肠道Lac-Phe分泌器，必需用于二甲双胍相关减重
articles.abstract: Metabolites are increasingly recognized as circulating molecules that regulate physiology, yet the mechanisms that couple local intracellular production to organism-wide action remain poorly defined. Using the anorexigenic metabolite N-lactoyl-phenylalanine (Lac-Phe) as a model system, we identify the orphan transporter MCT6/SLC16A5 as a physiologic intestinal Lac-Phe exporter.

articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), as it currently unfolds, is incompatible with a sustainable transformation of the economy, which arguably requires degrowth. AI is the growth paradigm reborn — built on enclosed commons, powered by fossil energy, and driven by a competitive logic that makes precaution structurally impossible. Limits to AI growth are not technophobia; they are our b
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）作为目前的发展模式，与经济的可持续转型相悖，后者或许需要退休。AI 是增长范式的重生——建立在封闭的公共领域，依赖化石能源，并由竞争逻辑驱动，这使得谨慎在结构上成为不可能。AI 的增长限制并非技术恐惧，而是所有人类可居住未来的最佳机会。

articles.title: Petition style changes with AI writing support but outcomes do not improve
articles.title_zh: 在AI写作支持下请愿风格改变但结果不提升
articles.abstract: In 2023, Change.org introduced an artificial intelligence (AI)-supported petition-drafting tool to their platform. With access to this tool, users’ petitions changed substantially, and their texts became more similar to one another. At the same time, overall petition outcomes did not improve, which shows the limits of AI integration into online advocacy communities.
articles.abstract_zh: 2023年，Change.org在其平台上引入了一个人工智能（AI）辅助的请愿草稿工具。在使用该工具的情况下，用户的请愿书发生了实质性变化，其文本相互之间变得更加相似。与此同时，总体请愿结果并未提升，这展示了AI整合到在线倡导社区的局限性。

articles.abstract: Recent whole-brain cell atlases have uncovered a consistent cytoarchitectural feature: the greatest diversity of discrete neuronal cell types resides not in the regions with the most neurons (e.g., the cortex and cerebellum) but rather in deep subcortical structures like the hypothalamus and brain stem. We propose that this discrepancy reflects a fundamental algorithmic divisio
articles.abstract_zh: 最近的全脑细胞图谱揭示了一个一致的细胞结构特征：离散神经元细胞类型的最大多样性并不出现在神经元数量最多的区域（如皮层和小脑），而是出现在深部皮层下结构，如下丘脑和脑干。我们提出，这种差异反映了脊椎动物大脑中“学习子系统”和“引导子系统”之间的基本算法划分。学习子系统（皮层、纹状体和小脑）通过复制重复模块来扩展，从而最大化计算容量，类似于机器学习模型中参数的扩展。相反，引导子系统（下丘脑、苍白球和脑干）通过多样化专门的细胞类型来编码本能驱

articles.title: Milking the niche: Microbial control of neonatal hematopoiesis
articles.title_zh: 挤压细分领域：微生物对新生儿造血的调控
articles.abstract: In this issue of Cell, Howard et al. reveal how the milk glycoprotein osteopontin shapes the neonatal microbiome to regulate hematopoiesis, promoting dendritic cell development and protection from severe respiratory infection. These findings uncover a maternal milk-microbiota pathway linking early-life nutrition to immune development and long-term disease susceptibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本期《细胞》杂志中，Howard 等人揭示了乳糖蛋白骨桥蛋白如何塑造新生儿微生物组以调节造血，促进树突状细胞发育并预防严重呼吸道感染。这些发现揭示了母乳-微生物通路，将早期营养与免疫发育及长期疾病易感性联系起来。
articles.snippet: In this issue of Cell, Howard et al. reveal how the milk glycoprotein osteopontin shapes the neonatal microbiome to regulate hematopoiesis, promoting dendritic cell development and protection from severe respiratory infection. These findings uncover a maternal milk-microbiota pathway linking early-life nutrition to immune development and long-term disease susceptibility.

The Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues (SMaHT) Network conducted large-scale benchmarking experiments involving cell lines and donor tissues to evaluate sequencing technologies, experimental approaches, and computational methods

articles.title: Charting the silent variation within us
articles.title_zh: 绘制我们内在的静默变异
articles.abstract: Every cell in the human body carries its own genome, shaped by mutations acquired over a lifetime, yet this vast somatic variation has been nearly impossible to measure. The SMaHT Network now delivers benchmarked tools and the first body-wide map of somatic mosaicism, establishing a baseline of "normal" against which its roles in development, aging, and disease can finally be t
articles.abstract_zh: 人体内的每个细胞都携带着自身的基因组，受到一生中获得的突变所塑造，但这种庞大的体细胞变异几乎无法测量。SMaHT 网络现在提供了经过基准测试的工具和首个全身体细胞嵌合图谱，确立了“正常”基线，从而可以最终检验其在发育、衰老和疾病中的作用。

articles.abstract: Why does performance pressure sometimes cause choking but sometimes elicit exceptional performance? We propose that pressure shifts the complexity of information-processing rules that guide action. Performance improves when shifts move processing toward task-matched complexity and deteriorates when they promote maladaptive simplification, overcomplexification, or the use of rul
articles.abstract_zh: 为什么绩效压力有时会导致失误，而有时又能激发卓越表现？我们提出，压力会改变指导行动的信息处理规则的复杂度。当压力使处理趋向与任务匹配的复杂度时，绩效会提升；当压力导致不适当的简化、过度复杂化或使用超出可用处理资源的规则时，绩效则会下降。

articles.title: Alus harbor genetic variants that shape the human cortex

articles.abstract: The genetic changes associated with development of the human cortex are difficult to test functionally, especially in the context of gene regulation. In this issue, Matoba et al. show that variants that shape human cortical structure are hiding inside Alu transposable elements, co-opting their inbuilt machinery to rewire regulatory networks in the developing brain.
articles.abstract_zh: 人类皮层发育相关的基因变化在功能层面难以检验，尤其是在基因调控的语境下。本期中，Matoba 等人展示了塑造人类皮层结构的变异隐藏在 Alu 转posable 元件内部，利用其内置机制在发育中大脑中重编织调控网络。

articles.title: Both selfish and prosocial actors distort their impact on others, but selfish-serving spin seems to spread
articles.title_zh: 自私与利他行为者都会扭曲对他人的影响，但自利的扭曲似乎更易传播
articles.abstract: From consumers buying fair-trade products to policy makers funding science, people often do not know exactly how their actions will affect others. We show that selfish and prosocial actors alike may distort their impact in self-serving ways, but selfish-serving distortions catch on more readily than prosocial-serving distortions and increase followers’ selfishness.
articles.abstract_zh: 从消费者购买公平贸易产品到政策制定者资助科学研究，人们往往不清楚自己的行为会如何影响他人。我们表明，自私与利他行为者都可能以自利的方式扭曲自己的影响，但自利的扭曲比利他的扭曲更易传播，并增加追随者的自私程度。
articles.snippet: From consumers buying fair-trade products to policy makers funding science, people often do not know exactly how their actions will affect others. We show that selfish and prosocial actors alike may distort their impact in self-serving ways, but selfish-serving distortions catch on more readily than prosocial-serving distortions and increase followers’ selfishness.

articles.title: Responsibilism and culture

articles.abstract: Previous research has widely associated East Asian cultures with higher levels of collectivism, which is often measured through self-report scales that emphasize warmth and prosociality towards all people. Talhelm et al. developed a responsibilism scale that captures duties and responsibilities in close relationships.
articles.abstract_zh: 以往研究广泛将东亚文化与较高的集体主义水平联系起来，这种集体主义常通过强调对所有人的温暖和利他行为的自评量表来衡量。Talhelm等人开发了一份责任主义量表，用于捕捉人际关系中的义务与责任。

articles.title: Recognizing Indigenous peoples
articles.title_zh: 承认原住民
articles.abstract: Settler states increasingly offer Indigenous peoples symbolic recognition, such as land acknowledgements, instead of political power or resources, yet the effects of these gestures are untested. Peyton and McNamee’s experiments in the USA and Australia find that land acknowledgements raise awareness of Indigenous peoples but reduce interest in learning more.
articles.abstract_zh: 殖民者国家越来越多地向原住民提供象征性的认可，如土地承认，却不提供政治权力或资源，然而这些举动的影响尚未得到检验。佩顿和麦克尼的美国和澳大利亚实验表明，土地承认提高了对原住民的认识，却降低了进一步了解的兴趣。

articles.title: A DNA Typewriter records the cell lineage history of a mouse, from zygote to late organogenesis

articles.abstract: Mammalian biology unfolds over time, within tissues and organs opaque to our eyes and instruments. We applied DNA Typewriter, a sequential molecular recorder, to record the cell lineage of a mouse over nearly two weeks of development. From one embryo, we reconstruct a time-calibrated, parsimony-supported, zygote-rooted phylogeny of 1.28 million transcriptionally profiled cells.

articles.title: Emotional optimization by newsroom AI needs behavioural evaluation

articles.abstract: When newsroom artificial intelligence (AI) engages in emotional packaging, it changes how a story feels, shaping whether people approach, trust and share it. As these systems are designed and deployed, AI and behavioural researchers should work together to test whether emotional packaging helps accurate information reach readers, and whether it deepens division.

articles.abstract: The recent controversies surrounding theories of consciousness invite a more fundamental reassessment of their scientific value. articles.abstract: Childhood maltreatment shapes brain development in ways that vary by adversity type, developmental timing, and genetic vulnerability to psychiatric illness-a heterogeneity that conventional approaches capture poorly. We contend that normative modeling, multivariate methods, and polygenic risk scores offer complementary frameworks for parsing this variability and advancing mecha

articles.abstract: Animal model tissues and biofluids are indispensable yet underused assets in preclinical research. We argue that standardized, shareable biobanks could reduce duplication, improve technical reproducibility, strengthen biomarker translation, lower animal use, and create scalable infrastructures for academia and industry.

articles.snippet: Animal model tissues and biofluids are indispensable yet underused assets in preclinical research. articles.abstract: Mitochondria arose from the endosymbiosis of a bacterium with an archaea-related host cell about 2 billion years ago. To understand their origins and evolution, we compared experimentally defined mitoproteomes from the MitoCarta Tree of Life project. Across eight organisms, we identified 8,619 distinct mitochondrial proteins within 3,199 families, of which 43% lack Pfam domains

articles.abstract: In this issue of Cell, Liu et al. introduce ULTRA, which combines rapid tissue clearing, single-channel stimulated Raman scattering microscopy, and AI to generate cell-resolved three-dimensional virtual histology of intact glioma specimens in about 30 minutes-fast enough to expose depth-dependent infiltration before surgery ends.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本期《Cell》杂志中，刘等人介绍了ULTRA，该技术结合快速组织清除、单通道激发拉曼散射显微镜和人工智能，在约30分钟内生成完整胶质瘤标本的细胞分辨三维虚拟组织学，速度足以在手术结束前揭示深度相关的浸润情况。

articles.title: Taking the heat: Breaking the temperature limits of eukaryotic life
articles.title_zh: 热力挑战：突破真核生物的温度极限
articles.abstract: What's the highest temperature at which complex life can grow? It's an old question. Here, Rappaport and colleagues describe a thermophilic amoeba that breaks the previous record, which was set at ∼60°C, and suggest the beginnings of an answer to what innovations enable this organism to take the heat.
articles.abstract_zh: 关于复杂生命能够生长的最高温度是什么？这是一个古老的问题。Rappaport及其同事在此研究中描述了一种耐高温的变形虫，它打破了此前约60°C的记录，并提出了可能使该生物能够承受高温的创新机制的初步答案。
articles.snippet: What's the highest temperature at which complex life can grow? It's an old question. Here, Rappaport and colleagues describe a thermophilic amoeba that breaks the previous record, which was set at ∼60°C, and suggest the beginnings of an answer to what innovations enable this organism to take the heat.

articles.title: Decoding mitochondrial proteomes of diverse eukaryotes
articles.title_zh: 多样真核生物线粒体蛋白组的解码
articles.abstract: Our textbook view of mitochondria, which has been shaped by studies in animals and yeast, fails to do justice to the organelle's broader eukaryotic diversity. While most mitochondria retain a tiny genome, the overwhelming majority of their proteins are nuclear-encoded and vary extensively across lineages. To map this diversity, the MitoCarta Tree of Life Consortium developed ex
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对线粒体的传统认识主要基于动物和酵母的研究，未能充分体现该细胞器在更广泛真核生物中的多样性。虽然大多数线粒体保留了极小的基因组，但其蛋白质的绝大多数是核编码的，并在不同谱系中差异显著。为绘制这一多样性图谱，MitoCarta Tree of Life Consortium 开发了实验和计算工作流程，生成了跨多种真核生物的高精度线粒体蛋白组，为比较线粒体生物学奠定基础，并对生理、进化和疾病产生广泛影响。

articles.abstract: Abstract Energy communities (ECs) are emerging as a key paradigm for decentralized, consumer-centric energy systems, yet their operation is challenged by uncertainty, asset heterogeneity, and the need for coordinated decision-making. Artificial intelligence (AI) has been widely applied to forecasting, optimization, and management of energy storage systems (ESSs) in ECs, but exi
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 能源社区（ECs）正成为去中心化、以消费者为中心的能源系统的关键范式，但其运行面临不确定性、资产异质性以及协调决策的需求。人工智能（AI）已广泛应用于能源社区中能源储存系统（ESS）的预测、优化和管理，但现有研究在决策层面仍显碎片化。本文对130篇同行评议的AI驱动预测、优化和ESS管理研究进行了全面系统的综述。通过共同分析这三大支柱，综述阐明了预测、处方和自适应组件如何相互作用，以及当前方法在支持端到端、可部署决策管道方面的不足

articles.abstract: Efforts to extinguish DEI provoke questions about the ongoing significance of diversity science. articles.title: Rethinking dementia prevention for a continuum of risk
articles.title_zh: 重新思考一系列风险下的痴呆预防
articles.abstract: Multiple modifiable risk factors for dementia commonly co-occur in a large proportion of the population, challenging the distinction between individuals at high risk and the wider population. Dementia prevention should therefore move beyond binary eligibility towards a combination of population-wide prevention and intensive interventions that reflect the continuum of risk.
articles.abstract_zh: 痴呆的多个可改变风险因素在大量人群中常共同出现，这挑战了高危人群与广大人群的界限。因此，痴呆预防应超越二元的资格标准，转向结合人群-wide预防和强化干预，以反映风险的连续性。
articles.snippet: Multiple modifiable risk factors for dementia commonly co-occur in a large proportion of the population, challenging the distinction between individuals at high risk and the wider population. articles.abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) accelerates bone healing and induces heterotopic ossification, raising the question of whether an injured brain benefits from bone. articles.title: Why girls have worse mental health than boys

articles.abstract: Analyses of data from more than 3,000 adolescents found that loneliness and desire for thinness contribute to the higher prevalence of depressive symptoms and suicidal ideation among girls than in boys. Young people’s perspectives informed the pathways that were investigated.

articles.title: What chimpanzees at war have taught me about being human
articles.title_zh: 黑猩猩之战让我学到了什么是人类
articles.abstract: Seeing a deadly ‘civil war’ unfold among chimpanzees has been a painful experience for John Mitani. His decades of watching wild great apes now evoke his family’s experience with xenophobia. But to him, the war highlights what makes humans unique: not our conflicts, but our unparalleled capacity for tolerance and cooperation.
articles.abstract_zh: 目睐野生大猩猴间‘内战’的惨烈过程，让约翰·米塔尼倍感痛苦。他数十年来对野生大猿的观察，如今唤起了自己家族遭受排外经历的记忆。然而在他看来，这场战争凸显了人类独有的特质：并非我们的冲突，而是无与伦比的容忍与合作能力。
articles.snippet: Seeing a deadly ‘civil war’ unfold among chimpanzees has been a painful experience for John Mitani. His decades of watching wild great apes now evoke his family’s experience with xenophobia. But to him, the war highlights what makes humans unique: not our conflicts, but our unparalleled capacity for tolerance and cooperation.
articles.authors_text: John C. Mitani

articles.title: There is no clear target for replication rates
articles.title_zh: 没有明确的复制率目标
articles.abstract: Is a 50% replication rate too high, too low or just right? We need a target replication rate to answer this question. Here, I evaluate two potential target rates, the ‘optimal’ replication rate and the ‘expected’ replication rate, and I call for an educational intervention to better appreciate their limitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 50%的复制率是否过高、过低或刚刚好？我们需要一个目标复制率才能回答这个问题。在此，我评估了两个潜在的目标复制率：‘最优’复制率和‘预期’复制率，并呼吁进行教育干预，以更好地认识到它们的局限性。
articles.snippet: Is a 50% replication rate too high, too low or just right? We need a target replication rate to answer this question. Here, I evaluate two potential target rates, the ‘optimal’ replication rate and the ‘expected’ replication rate, and I call for an educational intervention to better appreciate their limitations.
articles.authors_text: Mark Rubin

articles.title: Rising health inequities require looking beyond health systems
articles.title_zh: 健康不平等上升，视野需超越卫生系统
articles.abstract: Global health inequity is increasingly driven by the triple planetary crisis of climate change, biodiversity loss and pollution. To address it, we must place health at the centre of climate and environmental action and develop interventions that target both individual behaviours and structural drivers of inequality.
articles.abstract_zh: 全球健康不平等日益受到气候变化、生物多样性丧失和污染这三重星球危机的驱动。必须将健康置于气候和环境行动的中心，并开发针对个人行为和不平等结构性驱动因素的干预措施。
articles.snippet: Global health inequity is increasingly driven by the triple planetary crisis of climate change, biodiversity loss and pollution. To address it, we must place health at the centre of climate and environmental action and develop interventions that target both individual behaviours and structural drivers of inequality.
articles.authors_text: Nihan Toprakkiran, Marina Treskova, Jale Tosun, Alexander Zipf, Joacim Rocklöv

articles.title: How AI companions could deepen social inequality
articles.title_zh: AI 伴侣如何加剧社会不平等
articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) companions promise connection at low cost, but their effects are not evenly distributed. When user vulnerabilities, platform control loopholes, and governance gaps coincide, these systems risk deepening inequalities by exposing vulnerable users to more risks.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）伴侣以低成本承诺提供连接，但其影响并非均匀分布。当用户的脆弱性、平台的控制漏洞以及治理的空白同时出现时，这些系统有可能通过暴露弱势用户面临的更多风险来加剧不平等。
articles.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) companions promise connection at low cost, but their effects are not evenly distributed. When user vulnerabilities, platform control loopholes, and governance gaps coincide, these systems risk deepening inequalities by exposing vulnerable users to more risks.
articles.authors_text: Qiyang Zhang, Renwen Zhang, Nan Liu

articles.title: Meritocracy and inequality acceptance
articles.title_zh: 精英政治与不平等接受度
articles.abstract: The idea of meritocracy — that income differences should reflect performance rather than luck or inherited privilege — can be used to justify inequality. Yet people who consider meritocracy to be fair may disagree about redistribution. Understanding these disagreements can help to reduce polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: “精英政治”这一理念——即收入差异应反映个人表现而非运气或继承的特权——常被用来为不平等辩护。然而，认为精英政治公平的人可能在再分配问题上存在分歧。了解这些分歧有助于降低社会极化。
articles.snippet: The idea of meritocracy — that income differences should reflect performance rather than luck or inherited privilege — can be used to justify inequality. articles.abstract: Layer IV (L4) is the primary target of thalamic input to the neocortex. Its development varies from the thick L4 of primary sensory cortex to the thin L4 of primary motor cortex, which Nissl staining does not resolve. articles.title: The pathophysiology of depression in Huntington’s disease
articles.title_zh: 亨廷顿病抑郁症的病理生理学（Huntington’s disease）
articles.abstract: Depression affects Huntington's disease (HD) gene-expansion carriers at up to four times the general population rate, yet its neurobiological underpinnings remain inadequately understood, potentially contributing to persistent symptoms and suboptimal therapeutic outcomes, despite commonly used interventions. Understanding of the pathophysiological mechanisms remains constrained
articles.abstract_zh: 抑郁症在亨廷顿病（HD）基因扩增携带者中的发生率高达普通人群的四倍，然而其神经生物学基础尚未得到充分理解，可能导致症状持续存在和治疗效果不佳，尽管常用干预措施已被采用。对病理生理机制的理解受限于碎片化、单层面的方法，无法捕捉生物系统之间的相互作用。本文提出了一个多层次、相互作用的病理生理框架，整合了脑网络（宏观）、神经递质（中观）以及分子和系统（微观）层面的证据，阐明了HD中抑郁易感性的机制。我们强调了现有证据，表明HD相关的神经生物学

articles.title: The Microglia–Astrocyte–Neuron Lactate Shuttle model
articles.title_zh: 微胶质细胞–星形胶质细胞–神经元乳酸穿梭模型
articles.abstract: In a recent study, Adler and colleagues demonstrated that microglia regulate blood glucose delivery to fuel the astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle. As neuronal protein translation supported by this mechanism is essential for motor learning, these findings reveal how coordinated interactions among microglia, astrocytes, and neurons orchestrate neuroenergetics to support cognition.
articles.abstract_zh: 在最近的一项研究中，Adler 等人证明微胶质细胞调节血糖输送，以为星形胶质细胞-神经元乳酸穿梭提供能量。由于该机制支持的神经元蛋白翻译对运动学习至关重要，这些发现揭示了微胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞和神经元之间的协调相互作用如何共同调控神经能量代谢，以支持认知功能。
articles.snippet: In a recent study, Adler and colleagues demonstrated that microglia regulate blood glucose delivery to fuel the astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle. As neuronal protein translation supported by this mechanism is essential for motor learning, these findings reveal how coordinated interactions among microglia, astrocytes, and neurons orchestrate neuroenergetics to support cognition.

articles.abstract: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is a non-invasive magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) acquisition technique that can provide detailed information about brain microstructure. This methodology has historically been applied only to white matter tissue in the research context, but more recent literature suggests that diffusion MRI can also be applied to study microstructural alterati
articles.abstract_zh: 扩散加权成像（DWI）是一种非侵入性磁共振成像（MRI）采集技术，可提供关于脑微结构的详细信息。该方法历来主要用于白质研究，但近期文献提示扩散MRI也可用于研究灰质微结构变化，包括健康老龄化中的变化。本文是一篇叙述性综述，评估了研究灰质微结构年龄相关差异的扩散MRI文献及其对健康老年人认知功能理解的意义。所综述研究报道了广泛的皮质（尤其是额顶叶）、海马和皮下核微结构随年龄变化，这些变化与行为相关，尤其与学习和记忆等认知领域相关。灰质微结

articles.title: Metabolic atlas of early human cortex reveals glycolytic remodeling and pentose phosphate pathway control of cell fate transitions

articles.abstract: Cortical development involves rapid progenitor expansion and cell diversification supported by tightly regulated metabolic programs, yet these programs remain largely uncharacterized in human development. articles.title: Tunneling nanotubes in the nervous system: The fourth pillar of brain connectivity
articles.title_zh: 神经系统中的隧道状纳米管：大脑连接性的第四支柱
articles.abstract: Tunneling nanotubes (TNTs) are thin, actin-based membranous conduits that enable direct and indirect cytoplasmic exchange between distant cells. Once considered a rare in vitro phenomenon, TNTs are increasingly recognized as dynamic intercellular communication routes in the central nervous system. articles.title_zh: 神经病理性疼痛的研究：从疾病模型到治疗干预
articles.abstract: Neuropathic pain (NP) is a debilitating clinical condition arising from lesions or diseases of the somatosensory nervous system, affecting an estimated 3-17% of the global population and imposing a substantial burden on quality of life. articles.title: Molecular and functional heterogeneity of hypothalamic preoptic neurons
articles.title_zh: 下丘脑视前区神经元的分子与功能异质性
articles.abstract: The preoptic area of the hypothalamus (POA) has been long known for its involvement in brain functions that are critical for the survival of the individual and the species. The POA regulates essentially all homeostatic functions: sleep, temperature, stress responses, fluid and nutrient balance. articles.abstract_zh: 下丘脑视前区（POA）长期以来被认为参与维持个体与物种生存的关键脑功能。POA几乎调控所有体内稳态功能：睡眠、体温、应激反应、液体与营养平衡。同时，它在生殖及社会行为中也发挥突出作用，包括性行为、亲代行为、亲和行为和攻击行为。这些功能对物种适存至关重要，受到POA高度控制，并以性别特异和激素依赖方式进行调节。过去十年中，现代遗传学方法、生物传感技术与环路绘制揭示了POA内基于分子特征和连接模式的神经元亚群。阐明这些多样化神经元群体的功能

articles.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a diverse neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by ambiguous etiological mechanisms and the absence of recognized disease-modifying pharmacotherapies. articles.abstract: Classical serotonergic psychedelics primarily exert their profound effects through agonism at the serotonin 2A (5-HT2A) receptor, which is abundantly expressed in many cortical regions, particularly in layer V pyramidal neurons of associative and visual areas. At the cellular level, these receptors are predominantly localized postsynaptically on the soma and apical dendrites. T

articles.title: Associative learning explains “intuitive statistics” in animals.
articles.title_zh: 联想学习可解释动物中的“直觉统计”现象
articles.abstract: We review 58 experiments about "intuitive statistics" in mammals and birds, which investigate the animals' ability to make productive decisions when actions have probabilistic outcomes. We show that a stimulus-response associative model closely mirrors the animals' choices. The model reproduces qualitatively all results, and it accounts for an average 88% of the variance in 10
articles.abstract_zh: 我们回顾了58项关于哺乳动物和鸟类“直觉统计”的实验，这些实验考察了动物在行为结果具有概率性的情况下如何作出最优决策。我们发现，刺激-反应联结模型与动物的选择高度一致。该模型能够在定性上重现所有结果，并能解释37项针对鸟类和哺乳动物数据的10次定量拟合中平均88%的方差。未解释的方差并不意味着存在高于刺激-反应学习的更复杂过程，因为它要么位于测量误差范围内，要么源于动物比该模型预期作出更多错误决策。这些结果证实，联想学习模型是动物认知研

articles.title: Risk matters less when options are apples-to-oranges: The translate-and-accommodate model.
articles.title_zh: 当选项是“苹果对橘子”时，风险更不重要：翻译与适应模型
articles.abstract: Risk aversion for moderate-likelihood gains is perhaps the best-known stylized fact from decision research. Though studies documenting it have focused on decisions involving money, such behavior is presumed to prevail very generally, across diverse domains. We investigate the validity of this generalization by contrasting two types of decisions. In unimodal choices, outcomes ar
articles.abstract_zh: 对中等概率收益的风险规避或许是决策研究中最著名的经验规律。尽管相关研究多集中于金钱决策，这种行为被认为广泛适用于不同领域。我们通过对比两类决策来检验这一外推的有效性。在单模态决策中，结果是“苹果对苹果”——例如在确定与不确定的货币回报之间选择，或在确定获得某一产品与以概率获得多个单位该产品之间选择。跨模态决策中，结果是“苹果对橘子”——例如在确定获得一种产品与不确定获得另一种异质产品之间选择。我们观察到两种模式，说明跨模态情况下风险因素

Though studies documenting it have focused on decisions involving money, such behavior is presumed to prevail very generally, across diverse domains.
